\# Branch Naming Rules



The Digital Wallet Demonstration Platform follows a simple branch naming convention.



\## Main Branch



`main`



The `main` branch contains the stable and release-ready version of the project.



\## Feature Branches



Use:



`feature/<feature-name>`



Examples:



`feature/add-money`



`feature/wallet-refresh`



`feature/transaction-entry`



\## Bug Fix Branches



Use:



`fix/<bug-name>`



Examples:



`fix/wallet-balance`



`fix/refresh-count`



\## Documentation Branches



Use:



`docs/<documentation-name>`



Examples:



`docs/readme`



`docs/project-documentation`



\## Rules



\- Use lowercase letters.

\- Use hyphens instead of spaces.

\- Keep branch names short and meaningful.

\- Do not directly develop experimental features on `main`.

\- Merge completed features into the appropriate development/release branch after review.

\- Keep `main` stable.
